_about: PulseX configuration. Copy this file to zimage.json (next to zimage.py) and edit the paths for your machine; zimage.json is not checked in. Read by zimage.ps1 and zimage.py. Relative paths are resolved against the json's folder; {models} expands to paths.models. ZIMAGE_CONFIG may point to another file. Command-line options override the defaults.

_help.paths.models: folder with the three models below - keep it on a fast SSD (an SD card made weight loading 23x slower)
_help.paths.tokenizer: HF tokenizer folder, only used when the encoder server is not running
_help.paths.vae_full: full Flux VAE (safetensors), only for --vae full
_help.paths.taef1: bin/taef1_decode.exe - the fast C++ VAE decoder (the default)
_help.paths.bin: prebuilt binaries shipped in bin/ (llama-server, zimage-dit-stream, ggml, the DSP skel)
_help.paths.esrgan_x4: Real-ESRGAN x4 QNN context wrapped as ONNX (for 512 + upscale)
_help.paths.qnn_runtime: QNN/QAIRT runtime folder with QnnHtp.dll (for the upscaler)
_help.defaults.shift: sigma shift; 1.0 = linear schedule [1, .75, .5, .25], measurably more skin/fur detail than 3.0
_help.defaults.encoder: cpu reads the encoder weights straight from the file cache (~0.5 GB committed); npu is ~1 s faster on long prompts but commits ~2.8 GB
_help.defaults.upscale: 512 images are upscaled x4 with Real-ESRGAN and resized to upscale_to
_help.defaults.enrich: append material words to the prompt (cues.json), e.g. 'skin pores, catchlight in the eyes'
_help.defaults.unload_after_s: REPL: unload the image model and drop its cache after this many idle seconds (0 = never)
_help.server.port: port of the warm text-encoder server (llama-server)
_help.defaults.purge_on_start: REPL start: empty Windows' whole standby cache ('Cached') before the models load. standby | full (also trim every process's working set, like PulseCore Memory) | off. Only when PulseX runs as administrator; otherwise only PulseX's own model files are dropped.
_help.defaults.purge_on_exit: the same on 'zimage stop' and when the REPL closes
_help.defaults.upscale_detail: 0..1, how much of the Real-ESRGAN result is kept; the rest is a plain Lanczos enlargement. 1 = sharpest (can look plastic), 0 = softest.
